_about: Central Tracks hymns: public-domain words and tunes (published before 1929, and every writer dead more than 70 years, so they're free to use in the US and abroad), in our own modern arrangements. tools/make-hymns.py renders each into stems (drums, bass, keys, pad, electric guitar, strings, click, guide), a song file (sections, lyrics, chords, chart) and a preview mix. Format: chords = one entry per bar ("G", or several chords with the beat they start on: "G D@4"); a section's progression is a name or "name:from-to" (bars, 1-based); lyrics = the pickup, then one entry per bar, split by |; ~ joins a word across bars, / ends a lyric line, ^ marks where a bar's next chord falls.
